## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (1)
- `GET /sync` — Initiate or check authentication synchronization.

### Data Read (2)
- `GET /a/api/fastlane.json` — Retrieve Fastlane configuration data.
- `GET /sid/json` — Retrieve SID data in JSON format.

### Data Write (3)
- `POST /{id}` — Update or create a resource with a specific ID.
- `POST /api/header-bidding-request` — Submit a header bidding request to the system.
- `POST /openrtb/pbjs` — Submit an OpenRTB request via Prebid.js.

### Config (1)
- `GET /getconfig/sodar` — Retrieve the SODAR configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to System Gotsport's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access System Gotsport data without official API access
- Automate actions on system.gotsport.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the System Gotsport frontend uses
